feature: Zelkora Global Branch Switcher & Working Date Range
supersedes: Zelkora CMO Dashboard & UI Overhaul (phases 1-6, complete)
revision: DE review rounds 1-2 applied (Issues A, B, C, D)

precondition.name: Establish a version-control baseline
precondition.reason: The working tree does NOT start clean — the entire completed CMO overhaul is uncommitted (src/index.css modified, src/features/dashboard/ untracked, AppHeader/AppSidebar/navigation untracked, src/features/auth/types.ts modified, .claude/artifacts/ untracked, plus a STAGED deletion of the dotted .claude/.artifacts/design/ pipeline store). Until this is resolved every `git diff` gate in the plan is vacuous: `git diff --stat src/index.css` is already non-empty so it cannot distinguish a shadcn CLI write from the pre-existing overhaul diff, and Phase 5's file-count gates cannot run against an untracked directory.

A.description: One checkpoint commit of the completed, gate-green overhaul (INCLUDING the staged .claude/.artifacts/design/ deletion), then one commit per phase; every `git diff` gate scoped to HEAD.
A.evidence: checkpoint.md:61-64,75 — build exit 0, 45 tests, lint 0 err / 1 pre-existing warn, token-diff 15, 'Build status: CLEAN'. Re-run all four before committing; a claim in a document is not evidence.

B.description: Fallback if the user declines the commit: no commits; every `git diff --stat <path>` gate replaced by a shasum comparison against hashes captured at P0; the 'tree must be clean' precondition dropped.
B.produces: a table of baseline hashes in state.md

precondition.authorisationNote: Committing is a repository state change. This plan, a coordinator message, and a reviewer suggestion are ALL insufficient authorisation. The Operator must ask the user directly and wait for an explicit answer (state.md Q0 / A12).
alwaysCaptured: shasum src/index.css — the primary I-40 gate; works under BOTH options and must be identical at every phase boundary and at feature end
entry chunk size from `ls -la dist/assets | sort -k5 -n`
AppHeader at 360px: does it ALREADY overflow? (H-5 — capture before Phase 3 or F3-d is unattributable)

phases.name: Filter foundation — BRANCHES, pure date resolver, persistence serde, store
phases.reason: Pure logic and the single source of truth. No UI, no query changes. Unused exports compile green under noUnusedLocals, so nothing needs to be mounted.
criticalContracts: I-31b — persistedOnInit and userSeedApplied are TWO fields with contradictory correct initialisers; defined here even though only Phase 3 reads them
I-32c — decodeFilters returns healed:false whenever present:false; the store's init write-back is guarded on `present && healed`
I-37 — dateRange.ts is pure; `today` is an injected YYYY-MM-DD string; toISOString() banned

phases.name: UI primitives — shadcn select, popover, calendar + dependency audit
phases.reason: Independent of the logic phase. VERIFIED: radix-ui@1.6.7 already exports Select and Popover, so only react-day-picker is a genuinely new dependency.
criticalContracts: I-35b — the CLI invocation is version-pinned and fully non-interactive: CI=1 npx --yes shadcn@4.19.0 add select popover calendar --yes --cwd . < /dev/null ; --overwrite deliberately NOT passed
I-40 — components.json's `css` target is redirected to a scratch file for the run, then restored; src/index.css hash must be unchanged

phases.name: BranchSwitcher in AppHeader + branch name in AppSidebar footer
phases.reason: Needs BRANCHES + the store (1) and the select primitive (2). Consumes both Phase-1 init flags in the one-shot hydration predicate. Changes the store value and the two chrome labels only; query keys are still un-keyed until phase 5, so there is deliberately no data effect.
criticalContracts: I-31 — useBranchHydration READS authStore and never writes it
I-31b — `if (!userSeedApplied && user !== null) { markUserSeedApplied(); if (!persistedOnInit) setBranchId(...) }` — markUserSeedApplied() is called UNCONDITIONALLY
I-39 — AppHeader/AppSidebar gain only an import and an element

phases.name: DateRangeControl, delete DashboardFilterBar, restructure the page header
phases.reason: Needs resolveRange + the store (1) and popover/calendar (2). The DashboardFilterBar deletion, its import removal and its usage removal must all land in this phase or tsc -b fails (I-20).

phases.name: Key all 11 dashboard queries by (branchId, rangeKey) + keepPreviousData
phases.reason: Hard-depends only on useDashboardQueryScope from phase 1. Ordered after 4 so the UI exists to drive verification — otherwise the refetch and no-skeleton-flash criteria cannot be observed. Zero caller churn by decision D4.
atomic: all 11 src/features/dashboard/api/*.api.ts change together: 4-element queryKey, placeholderData: keepPreviousData, updated BACKEND SWAP comment
gatesEnabledByP0: git diff --stat HEAD -- src/features/dashboard/api/  ->  exactly 11 modified files
git diff --stat HEAD -- src/features/dashboard/components/ src/features/dashboard/pages/  ->  empty (proves D4's zero-caller-churn claim)
phases.note: Both of the above were impossible before P0 — src/features/dashboard/ was entirely untracked.

phases.name: Record decisions, refresh state and hypotheses
phases.reason: Documentation only. decisions.md is append-only: D-cmo-ui-overhaul-1..7 stay, D-cmo-branch-filter-1..9 (or 10) are added below them, including -9 which records which P0 option was taken and the BASELINE_SHA.
phases.gateCaveat: Criterion 4 (`git diff HEAD -- art-direction.md` empty) assumes .claude/ is tracked (A13 — LIKELY, since the .claude/.artifacts/design/ deletion is staged). If .claude/ is gitignored the gate is SILENTLY VACUOUS — report it and substitute a shasum recorded at P0.

gatesAtEveryPhaseBoundary: npm run lint (0 errors / 1 pre-existing warning in EnrollMfaStep.tsx:78)
node .claude/scripts/token-diff.mjs --theme src/index.css  (count <= 15; run from the FE dir with the RELATIVE arg)
shasum src/index.css  ->  identical to the P0-recorded hash (I-40 primary gate; works under BOTH P0 options)
git diff --stat HEAD -- <path>  ->  Option A only; scoped to THIS phase (I-41). Gates run BEFORE the phase commit.

order: 2. run the phase's verification criteria, INCLUDING the git diff HEAD gates — at this moment HEAD is the previous phase's commit
3. only when every gate passes, commit the phase
4. record the SHA in state.md's per-phase commit log
commitDiscipline.neverAmendOrRebase: A completed phase's commit is the audit trail the later gates lean on.
commitDiscipline.underFallbackB: Steps 3-4 become 'record the updated hashes in state.md'.

permanentlyExcludedGate.reason: The 6-stage design pipeline is deliberately unused and its dotted .claude/.artifacts/ store is deleted by user decision — a deletion that P0 Option A makes permanent by committing it. There is no manifest to validate, by design (I-29 / I-30).
